title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - DailyActivity
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/DailyActivity. The patient/user activities that occur during daytime (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf Activity. The source ttl declares no rdfs:domain property for DailyActivity itself -- it is a pure specialization. It therefore inherits activityDuration and velocity from Activity (see standards/saref4ehaw/models/Activity/schema.json) with nothing of its own declared in the source ontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DailyActivity'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
